title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Everest Forms Everest…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in Everest Forms up to version 3.6.4. This flaw allows an attacker to improperly limit a pathname to a restricted directory, potentially leading to denial of service. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.6 and does not require user interaction or privileges to exploit.
